text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Left, right, left... Kita,
your right foot!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Urgh! I feel like my legs are gonna cramp
up!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Let's take a little break.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You taking the lead makes dancing a
whole lot
easier... but I still don't know if
I'm doing it right!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're doing fine. With a little more
practice,
you'll be gliding across the
dance floor.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Gliding?! Th-that doesn't really sound
like me...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that was such a cute dance! ♪ Are
you
practicing for the Ligne Droite?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Ballroom dancing is a little
difficult for me. With all the new
students coming next month, I wanted to
dance real cool, like a good 
upperclassman should.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Sure thing. All right, dance with me,
Satono!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, but I was hoping I could just
watch too!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Then, who else could I... Oh, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Shakur, help me out! Satono and Kita
are
preparing for the Droite, and—

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Pass.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What?! But you didn't even let me finish.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I knew what it was the moment I heard
"Droite." I
couldn't care less about that
thing!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Please, won't you grant me the honor of

becoming your partner?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Hah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you let your guard down! ♪
Satono and Kita want to see what a
proper ballroom dance
looks like. Don't
twirl me too aggressively.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you make it so confusing? I
thought you
were gonna ask me to the
real thing! Also...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Height-wise, shouldn't I be the one asking?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Shakur, you're such a good lead!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I pay attention in class. Why
would I waste
my time having to do
extra work rehearsing?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so cool! They're gliding around so

elegantly!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
They look effortless, not one flaw in
their
footwork. We have to reach their
level.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you're right! Break time's over,
let's get
back to practice!
